test_cases.title: Verify double clicking Football prevents concurrent actions [Edge]
test_cases.description: Ensures click action is throttled/debounced on critical button Football Button to avoid duplicate transaction entries.
preconditions: Target control is enabled and ready to accept double interaction triggers
Browser session is active and stable

steps.action: Rapidly trigger double clicks on Football in quick succession (interval < 100ms).
steps.expected: The system registers only the first click, debouncing the second trigger.
steps.system_response: The system registers only the first click, debouncing the second trigger.

steps.action: Inspect network requests to confirm only a single API call was dispatched for the Football interaction.
steps.expected: Exactly one network request is visible in the request log; no duplicate calls are recorded.
steps.system_response: Exactly one network request is visible in the request log; no duplicate calls are recorded.

test_cases.expected_result: Only a single execution request for the Football action is processed by the application server, safely debouncing subsequent clicks and preventing duplicate entries.
